description: Search the curated treasures (kunuz): short verbatim spans picked from the lectures and classified. wassaya = advices; memorable_quotes = memorable sayings of the scholar; hadith_fawaid = benefits drawn from a hadith; tafsir_fawaid = benefits from a verse; sira_ibrah = lessons from the Sira and history; imam_sayings = sayings of earlier scholars he quotes; glad_tidings = glad tidings; diagnostic_observations = diagnoses of the Ummah's problems; qa_pairs = questions and answers; books_recommended = books he recommends. Matches the verbatim text (Arabic).
name: search_treasures
title: Search the treasures
